text.p: West winds of 20-50 mph are expected across the English Channel and southern North Sea, as well as the coastal UK and northwestern mainland Europe today. Wind damage may occur. Problems will continue for shipping. Winds will diminish somewhat by Wednesday.

Tropical Cyclone Karlette, with 40 mph winds, is in the southern Indian Ocean near 37s/60e, moving south southeast at 20 mph. Karlette is expected to turn southeast and increase its forward speed, becoming extratropical in about 24 hours. It is only a threat to shipping.
Rain from dissipated Tropical Cyclone Ita should come to an end over Queensland, Australia, this period, but a few locally heavy rain squalls and flash floods are possible in the next 12 hours.
Rain squalls from dissipated Tropical Cyclone 27S may make it into western West Australia with local downpours and flash flooding, but widespread problems are not expected.
